name: Tinker: Mechsuit effectiveness passives modify the suit's own effect values
contract: #668, #501: Turbo Upgrade (707115) and Augmechtation (503568) are ordinary family-34 spell modifiers on the Mechsuit helper auras and need no script. Turbo Upgrade carries SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS at 100%, so every effect value of Mechsuit 801385 and Mechsuit 803329 doubles for a Tinker who knows it. Augmechtation carries SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 at a flat 10, so it adds exactly 10 to effect index 2 of 801385 (the MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE amount) and leaves effect index 0 of 803329 untouched. The values are read through the native effect calculation for this caster, which is what AscensionTinker's SetHelper casts use, so a lost modifier fails the run.
